questions.question: What does adain(features, scale, bias) normalize before applying style?
options: It standardizes the feature vector with its mean and standard deviation, then returns scale*(f-m)/s + bias
It softmaxes features and adds the raw latent vector
It clips each feature to [-1,1] without changing its mean
It replaces every feature with the same scale value
questions.explanation: adain calls mean_std and applies an affine transform to normalized features, letting a style-derived scale and bias control the channel statistics.

questions.question: What shape does mapping(z, init_mapping(8, 8, depth=4, ...)) preserve at every layer?
options: A 4-element vector
An 8-element vector
A vector that grows from 8 to 32 elements
A scalar style score
questions.explanation: init_mapping builds dimensions [8,8,8,8,8], so each of the four leaky-ReLU layers maps an 8-wide vector to another 8-wide vector.

questions.question: How many synthesis blocks does stylegan_forward execute?
options: One block followed by a classifier head
Four blocks because the mapping depth is four
Three blocks, each optionally applying AdaIN and noise
As many blocks as the length of w
questions.explanation: The loop `for i in range(3)` applies W0/b0 through W2/b2 and their corresponding style/noise operations.

questions.question: What happens to the output when stylegan_forward uses the same w and noise_sigma=0.1 but different noise seeds?
options: Only the output mean changes; every coordinate remains identical
The mapping vector w is replaced by a new random vector every layer
The output becomes deterministic because noise is disabled
The global style stays fixed while per-layer stochastic detail can change
questions.explanation: The fixed w and constant preserve the style path, while each block adds noise_sigma*rng.gauss(0,1), making details seed-dependent.

questions.question: What does psi=0.0 select in the truncation loop?
options: w_bar, the mean mapping vector, because w_psi = w_bar + psi*(w_test-w_bar)
w_test, because psi is ignored by the formula
A zero vector regardless of w_bar
The average of the synthesis activations
questions.explanation: At psi=0, the interpolation term vanishes and the synthesis network receives the empirical mean w_bar.

questions.question: Why are scale{i} and bias{i} multiplied by w separately for every synthesis block?
options: They force every block to use the same random noise sample
They let the mapped latent control feature statistics at different layers and therefore different levels of image structure
They convert a scalar class ID into a vocabulary distribution
They remove the need for the learned W{i} matrices
questions.explanation: Each block computes its own style-derived scale and bias, illustrating StyleGAN's per-layer control instead of one latent injected only at the input.
